    Complete sets of primitive orthogonal idempotents #

    Every idempotent of a finite-dimensional algebra is a sum of pairwise orthogonal primitive idempotents: split a nonprimitive idempotent f as g + (f - g) with g an idempotent of the corner fAf, and induct on dim fA. In particular a finite-dimensional algebra has a complete set of primitive orthogonal idempotents (exists_primitive_decomposition), as used in Lemma 2.1 (graded-category.tex).
